component.name: Divider
component.description: A horizontal rule that visually separates sections of content. Styled with the default border token. No props beyond className.

useWhen: Separating distinct sections within a Card or page layout
Creating visual breaks between list items or content groups

patterns.name: section-break
patterns.description: Divider placed between two Stacks inside a Card to visually separate form sections.

useWhen.default: Horizontal rule with the default border token.

rules.case: Using Divider as a top or bottom border for a container
rules.because: Card and Box have border tokens already. Adding a Divider duplicates the visual boundary.
rules.do: Use the container's existing border. Reserve Divider for internal content separation.

rules.case: Adding margin to Divider to control spacing
rules.because: Divider has no margin by design — spacing belongs to the parent layout primitive.
rules.do: Control spacing with the gap prop on the surrounding Stack.
